commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create dedicated system account =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc
id inventorysvc

echo "== STEP 2: write systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=OS Comparison Inventory Worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

echo "== STEP 3: reload, enable, start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

echo "== STEP 4: verify =="
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
echo "== process owner =="
ps -o user,pid,cmd -C os-comparison-worker || ps aux | grep os-comparison-worker | grep -v grep
